verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription monetization and billing platform, so usage-based metering is a fair axis for it. The evidence only documents purchase/receipt ingestion (POST /receipts imports), subscription status, and outbound webhooks. Nothing shows ingestion of high-volume usage events such as API calls, tokens or compute-seconds, and nothing documents idempotency keys or backdated event timestamps. Receipt import is a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream high-volume usage events — API calls, tokens, compute-seconds — into a metering pipeline with idempotent ingestion and backdating support
